newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 93 Kurd guerrillas killed in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 93 Kurd guerrillas killed in clashes.

text.p: Turkey said on Tuesday its security forces had killed 93 Kurdish guerrillas in two days of clashes in the southeast of the country.

The regional governor's office in the city of Diyarbakir said in a statement that the fighting took place in the provinces of Diyarbakir and Hakkari, near the Iraqi border. It said nine members of the security forces had also died.
No independent confirmation of the death toll was immediately available.

Tens of thousands of troops have been building up near the mountainous border with Iraq in recent weeks in preparation for a possible assault on Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) positions. The rebels have bases on both sides of the border.
More than 22,000 people have died in 12 years of conflict between troops and the guerrillas, fighting for Kurdish self rule.
Rebel leader Abdullah Ocalan called at the weekend for a peaceful solution to the Kurdish problem.
